Senses.Explanation: The teaching hall is the monastery building containing the public teaching seat and assembly floor. Niutou Huizhong’s biographies repeatedly locate public movement and speech there, while Yunyan Tansheng’s record makes the building part of an encounter. Imperial-occasion directions also use it as an ordinary venue, so animated hall imagery does not erase the architectural referent.
